short_summary: Safeguarding 70000+ specimens organoids and models to support collaborative pediatric oncology research.
long_title: Translational Pediatric Biobank and Model Infrastructure
long_purpose: Maintain and expand a high-quality specimen and model repository that accelerates pediatric oncology discovery and validation workflows.
long_patient_impact: Supports reproducible translational studies and faster cross-lab collaboration to move therapies toward patients.
keywords: Biobank infrastructure; organoids; specimen quality; collaborative science

short_summary: Converting polyamine-targeted maintenance into a senescence-to-apoptosis relay for high-risk neuroblastoma.
long_title: Sequential Senescence-Targeted Maintenance for DFMO-Sensitized HRNB
long_purpose: Convert DFMO-driven senescence into rapid tumor clearance in high-risk neuroblastoma using timed senolytic sequencing.
long_patient_impact: DFMO can stabilize growth arrest but residual senescent cells may sustain relapse risk in maintenance settings.
keywords: Benchmark sequential DFMO then senolytic schedules across cell lines organoids and syngeneic models with polyamine and SASP biomarkers.

short_summary: Pairing opaganib with oxaliplatin and doxorubicin to trigger durable immune surveillance in relapsed neuroblastoma.
long_title: Adaptive-Immune Priming Strategy Layering Lipid Modulators onto OXA/DOX
long_purpose: Test whether opaganib added to oxaliplatin and doxorubicin increases immunogenic cell death in relapsed neuroblastoma.
long_patient_impact: Relapsed neuroblastoma needs regimens that improve immune activation without substantially increasing treatment toxicity.
keywords: Measure ER stress calreticulin HMGB1 antigen presentation and adaptive immune memory in clinically relevant models.
